name: Contact List Merge
prompt: There are two contact files on the desktop: workspace/contacts_a.json and workspace/contacts_b.json. Merge them into one list and deduplicate by email (case-insensitive). If the same email appears in both files, keep the record from file b. Finally sort by email in alphabetical order, and save to workspace/merged_contacts.json on the desktop, in the format of a JSON array. Each contact has the fields name, email, phone, and department.
